name: UF-style-geometric
note: geometric — sharp faceted forms; ENDESGA-16 + pixel-art angles 1.5 straighten every edge. — unfake grid snap (true model grid, reduced to the canvas), despeckle 0. Twin of FACTORY/style-geometric.  (sample: seed 1412)

form.subject: a (crystal golem:1.3) made of (jagged purple amethyst shards:1.3)
form.negative: (3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (multiple, sprite sheet, collage:1.3), cropped

sample_command: pixelmon 'a (crystal golem:1.3) made of (jagged purple amethyst shards:1.3)' --server rtx --no-open --show-prompt --lora pixel-art-xl.safetensors --lora-strength 1 --negative '(3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (multiple, sprite sheet, collage:1.3), cropped' --style geometric,solo --out 192x192 --palette ENDESGA-16 --despeckle 0 --snap-pixels --snap-method unfake --pixel-size 1x1 --thin-lines 2 --pixel-angles 1.5 --seed 1412
